text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(If she wins today's race, it'll be so 
hype...! She got a great gate, too. 
...Alright, great start!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(She's a bit buried in the pack, maybe... 
No, it's fine. If it's her, if just a 
little... if just a tiny opening appears, 
I'm sure—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Announcer-san? Why... Wait, wait, 
no way...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Her name...!! Her name wasn't 
called...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I wish they called out every single 
runner's name... I mean, I know it's 
tough, but still... Urghhhh~~~~!!
